plain: An official demand or formal request

webster.text: Demand; application made as of right.

example.quote: The requisition of 1783 was commensurate with the interest of the debt, as it was then calculated; but it has been more accurately ascertained since that time.
example.cite: The Address and Reasons of Dissent of the Minority of the Convention of Pennsylvania to Their Constituents, Pennsylvania Packet and Daily Advertiser, Dec. 18, 1787
